shared_elements: tall vertical slab/monument with rounded top and outline
justification: Both are tall, vertically oriented rounded-topped stone surfaces covered with dense relief in rounded-rectangular compartments, and both include prominent circular disc motifs and horizontal register divisions. The decisive difference is that A centres on a single large three-dimensional anthropomorphic figure with headdress, chest disc and belt bands, whereas B is a strictly gridded two-column, twelve-row array of abstract sign blocks with no figure — and the rendering (weathered photographed stone versus crisp modern line drawing) shares no manner of execution.
